REMARKABLE VILLAGE ON THE EDGE OF THE SKIN. One of the most remarkable and picturesque villages in Natute in the Italian Tripalis, situated on the edge of the Sahara Desert. The Arab inhabitants live in their self-made village in the houses of the most weird and primitive architecture - being built into an old cliff. These houses have no windows and are kept shut up by means of heavy weeden doors. Steep steps enable the to go down to the narrow street below, which is used as a market-place. O.P.S. A view of the quaint Arabian Village built in the side of a cliff BRU showing the weird houses.
